body.text: We are short of {param:lacking} at {param:town}. There are {param:held} in the store and the month is not out.
I shall not dress it up: we are {perception:larder}, and the people are {perception:spirits}.
I have written of this before and had no answer.
I can turn hands to it if that is your wish. It will cost us elsewhere, and I would rather be told than guess.

tone.text: On the matter of the {param:lacking}, I am {choice}.

options.text: glad you wrote before it grew worse
as troubled by it as you are

steps.prompt: What is to come first at {param:town}

options.label: attend to the colony's profit
options.text: Attend to the colony's profit. That is what you are there for, and what the Crown will ask me about.

options.label: see that the town grows
options.text: See that the town grows. A place with nobody in it returns nothing, whatever the ledgers say.

options.label: see to your defences
options.text: See to your defences. I would rather pay for walls I did not need than explain why there were none.

options.label: plant a new settlement
options.text: Plant a new settlement. One town is a foothold; it is not a colony.

options.label: your people's survival must come first
options.text: Your people's survival must come first. Everything else can wait on it, and I will hear no argument.

tone.annoyed: I trust I shall not have to write again,
